sources.evidence: CARIB Brewery's current official St Kitts & Nevis page states that the brewery is located on St. Kitts and that CARIB Brewery (St. Kitts & Nevis) Limited manufactures and distributes 25 alcoholic and non-alcoholic beverages; the page lists current products including Carib Lager, Carib Pilsner, Carib Radler, Stag Lager, Skol Lager, Guinness Stout, Mackeson Stout, Royal Extra Stout, Vita Malt, Giant Malt, Smalta, Ting, Pink Ting, Peardrella, Ginseng Up, Smirnoff and Heineken.
CARIB Brewery's current official product information states that Giant Malt is brewed and bottled by CARIB Brewery (St Kitts & Nevis) Ltd.
CARIB Brewery's current official contacts page identifies the St Kitts operation at Buckley's Site, Basseterre, St Kitts.
